title: The same region rotates about two different axes
stem: R is bounded by y=ln x, y=0 and x=e, with 1≤x≤e.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the volume when R rotates about the x-axis.

title: A convergent improper integral with a tail estimate
stem: Consider $J=\int_1^\infty(\ln x)/x^2\,dx$. Interpret this as a limit of integrals with finite upper endpoint B.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Evaluate J and justify convergence.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the exact error if the upper endpoint is replaced by e², and explain the sign.

steps.text: Integration by parts gives $\int_1^B(\ln x)/x^2\,dx=1-(\ln B+1)/B$.
The finite integral underestimates J because the integrand is nonnegative on [1,∞).

diagramCaption: Original mathematical diagram. Use exact values stated in the question; do not measure the drawing.
answerSummary: $J=1$, so the integral converges. The finite integral underestimates J because the integrand is nonnegative on [1,∞).
